ucs.title: [LLM] Conti / Wizard Spider AdFind reconnaissance using leaked-playbook flags & output files
ucs.description: Hunts AdFind execution patterns that match the August 2021 Conti playbook leak (trustdmp, -subnets, -gcb -sc, ad_users.txt / ad_computers.txt / trustdmp.txt). Conti/UNC1878 affiliates ran this verbatim sequence pre-lateral-movement on virtually every documented intrusion (TrickBot/BazarLoader → Cobalt Strike → AdFind → PsExec → Conti).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_path) as path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="adfind.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="AdFind.exe" OR Processes.process="*adfind*") AND (Processes.process="*trustdmp*" OR Processes.process="*-subnets*" OR Processes.process="*-gcb -sc*" OR Processes.process="*objectcategory=person*" OR Processes.process="*objectcategory=computer*" OR Processes.process="*objectcategory=subnet*" OR Processes.process="*objectcategory=organizationalUnit*" OR Processes.process="*name=\"Domain Admins\"*" OR Processes.process="*ad_users.txt*" OR Processes.process="*ad_computers.txt*" OR Processes.process="*ad_ous.txt*" OR Processes.process="*trustdmp.txt*" OR Processes.process="*dcmodes*" OR Processes.process="*adinfo*") by host Processes.user Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user, "(?i)\\$$")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
// Conti playbook AdFind recon — leaked Aug-2021 verbatim flags
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName =~ "adfind.exe"
      or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "AdFind.exe"
      or ProcessCommandLine has "adfind")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "trustdmp", "-subnets", "-gcb -sc",
    "objectcategory=person", "objectcategory=computer",
    "objectcategory=organizationalunit", "objectcategory=subnet",
    "name=\"Domain Admins\"",
    "ad_users.txt", "ad_computers.txt", "ad_ous.txt", "trustdmp.txt",
    "dcmodes", "adinfo"
  )
| where AccountName !endswith "$"             // exclude machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Conti playbook AdFind recon — Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\adfind.exe" or CommandLine has "adfind")
| where CommandLine has_any (
    "trustdmp", "-subnets", "-gcb -sc",
    "objectcategory=person", "objectcategory=computer",
    "objectcategory=organizationalunit", "objectcategory=subnet",
    "name=\"Domain Admins\"",
    "ad_users.txt", "ad_computers.txt", "ad_ous.txt", "trustdmp.txt",
    "dcmodes", "adinfo"
  )
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName,
          CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Conti AdFind Reconnaissance Matching Leaked-Playbook Flags
id: 1b7f4c20-conti-adfind
status: experimental
description: Detects AdFind execution patterns from the August 2021 Conti playbook leak — trustdmp, -subnets, -gcb -sc and the canonical output filenames Conti operators redirected to.
references:
  - https://github.com/ForbiddenProgrammer/conti-pentester-guide-leak
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa21-265a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/07
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_bin:
    Image|endswith: '\adfind.exe'
  selection_name:
    OriginalFileName: 'AdFind.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: 'adfind'
  selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'trustdmp'
      - '-subnets'
      - '-gcb -sc'
      - 'objectcategory=person'
      - 'objectcategory=computer'
      - 'objectcategory=organizationalUnit'
      - 'objectcategory=subnet'
      - 'ad_users.txt'
      - 'ad_computers.txt'
      - 'ad_ous.txt'
      - 'trustdmp.txt'
      - 'name="Domain Admins"'
  condition: (selection_bin or selection_name or selection_cmd) and selection_args
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned red-team or AD audit engagements
level: high
tags:
  - attack.discovery
  - attack.t1018
  - attack.t1087.002
  - attack.t1482
  - attack.g0102
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@Image:(*\\adfind.exe OR *\\AdFind.exe OR *\\ADFIND.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*adfind* OR *AdFind* OR *ADFIND*)) @CommandLine:(*trustdmp* OR *-subnets* OR *"-gcb -sc"* OR *objectcategory=person* OR *objectcategory=computer* OR *objectcategory=subnet* OR *objectcategory=organizationalUnit* OR *ad_users.txt* OR *ad_computers.txt* OR *ad_ous.txt* OR *trustdmp.txt* OR *"Domain Admins"*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\adfind\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/adfind/i
| regex("(trustdmp|-subnets|-gcb\s+-sc|objectcategory=(person|computer|organizationalUnit|subnet)|ad_users\.txt|ad_computers\.txt|ad_ous\.txt|trustdmp\.txt|name=\"Domain Admins\")", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
ucs.rationale: The output filenames (ad_users.txt, ad_computers.txt, ad_ous.txt, trustdmp.txt) and the exact -f filter strings appeared in the leaked Conti operator guide. Generic AdFind detections fire on every pentester; this one fires on Conti/Wizard Spider tradecraft specifically because we require BOTH the binary AND the leak-published argument set.

ucs.title: [LLM] Conti pre-encryption host neutralization chain (vssadmin + bcdedit + wbadmin + wevtutil within 10 min)
ucs.description: Detects the Conti / Wizard Spider pre-encryption sabotage sequence: shadow-copy deletion via vssadmin or wmic, recovery disablement via bcdedit, backup catalog wipe via wbadmin, and event-log clearing via wevtutil — all on the same host inside a tight window. Conti's CARBON SPIDER-style playbook executes this combo seconds before dropping the encryptor; a single command is noisy, but ≥2 distinct sabotage actions on one host in 10 min is near-pathognomonic.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_name) as binaries values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND (Processes.process="*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*systemstatebackup*" OR Processes.process="*backup*")) OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wevtutil.exe" AND (Processes.process="* cl *" OR Processes.process="*clear-log*")) by host _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval distinct_actions = mvcount(binaries)
| where distinct_actions >= 2
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Conti pre-encryption sabotage — ≥2 distinct destructive actions on one host in 10 min
let Window = 10m;
let Sabotage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1d)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"     and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has "delete"
                                       and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","systemstatebackup","backup"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"  and (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("recoveryenabled","no")
                                            or ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures")))
         or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (" cl ","clear-log"))
    | extend Action = case(
        FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe",  "vss_delete",
        FileName =~ "wmic.exe",      "wmic_shadow_delete",
        FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe",   "wbadmin_delete",
        FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe",   "bcdedit_disable_recovery",
        FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe",  "log_clear",
        "other");
Sabotage
| summarize Actions = make_set(Action),
            DistinctActions = dcount(Action),
            FirstAction = min(Timestamp),
            LastAction  = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmds  = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Users       = make_set(AccountName, 5)
            by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where DistinctActions >= 2                  // 2+ distinct sabotage families = Conti chain signature
| order by FirstAction desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Conti pre-encryption sabotage chain — Sentinel 4688
let Window = 10m;
let Sabotage = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe"  and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe"     and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe"  and CommandLine has "delete"
                                                     and CommandLine has_any ("catalog","systemstatebackup","backup"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"  and (CommandLine has_all ("recoveryenabled","no")
                                                          or CommandLine has_all ("bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures")))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wevtutil.exe" and CommandLine has_any (" cl ","clear-log"))
    | extend Action = case(
        NewProcessName endswith "vssadmin.exe",  "vss_delete",
        NewProcessName endswith "wmic.exe",      "wmic_shadow_delete",
        NewProcessName endswith "wbadmin.exe",   "wbadmin_delete",
        NewProcessName endswith "bcdedit.exe",   "bcdedit_disable_recovery",
        NewProcessName endswith "wevtutil.exe",  "log_clear",
        "other");
Sabotage
| summarize Actions = make_set(Action),
            DistinctActions = dcount(Action),
            FirstAction = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastAction  = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmds  = make_set(CommandLine, 10)
            by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where DistinctActions >= 2
| order by FirstAction desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* AND *shadows*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* AND *delete*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* AND (*catalog* OR *systemstatebackup* OR *backup*))) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:((*recoveryenabled* AND *no*) OR (*bootstatuspolicy* AND *ignoreallfailures*))) OR (@Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*" cl "* OR *clear-log*)))
ucs.rationale: Backup admins run vssadmin/wbadmin in isolation; Windows updates run bcdedit alone; SOC engineers clear logs alone. Conti deploys the encryptor only AFTER chaining vssadmin → bcdedit → wbadmin → wevtutil in seconds.
